title: Verification policy registry
canonical_definition: Bind jobs to exact versioned verification policies before execution.

milestone_relationship.rationale: CMP-1.4.3 changes the shared JobRegistry pre-execution guard and completes the first three verifier slices; the retained full Compute Market suite is the app-specific Level 2 integration gate.

implementation.binding: ACCEPTED job freezes exact policyId/revision/commitment before assignment in a CMP-1.4.3-qualified configuration.
implementation.compatibility: Historical JobRegistry fixtures without a bound verification policy registry remain legacy-compatible; they are not CMP-1.4.3-qualified for new execution.

authority_boundaries: Policy publication is not a verdict, verifier identity, class/capability grant, appointment, correctness proof, settlement, custody, stake/slash, governance, worker, validator, bridge or arbitrary-wallet authority.
A bound policy is immutable job provenance; later publication or suspension cannot reinterpret the accepted job.
The owner may bind only a current accepting KIND_VERIFICATION revision/commitment while the job is ACCEPTED and before execution.
Binding increments the canonical job revision so stale execution attempts fail closed.
A CMP-1.4.3-qualified JobRegistry configuration cannot enter RUNNING without a frozen verification policy.
exit_criteria: Existing ComputePolicyRegistry420 KIND_VERIFICATION is reused as the canonical versioned publication authority.
A job can freeze exact policy ID, revision and commitment only while ACCEPTED and before execution.
CMP-1.4.3-qualified assignment fails closed until policy binding exists.
Only current accepting KIND_VERIFICATION revisions with exact commitments may be newly bound.
Policy binding increments job revision and cannot be repeated or silently replaced.
Later policy revision/suspension cannot rewrite a previously bound job.
Policy binding grants no unrelated authority.
Level 1 and documented Level 2 Compute Market qualification are green on the exact implementation SHA.
